weather_report:
As the afternoon unfolds in Boston, the sky is shrouded in a thick quilt of clouds, casting an overcast pallor over the city. The air carries a damp chill, intensifying the sense of the day’s blend of fog and impending storms. With winds swirling around at a brisk pace, punctuated by gusty bursts, one feels the omnipresent moisture in the air, hinting at the rain that has already begun to lightly patter against windows and sidewalks.

The forecast forebodes an evening equally draped in humidity, with heavy rains set to accompany the patchy fog that will linger well into the night. It is advisable to don a waterproof jacket and sturdy footwear if venturing outside, as the weather lays a rather gloomy tableau, demanding a sensible approach to comfort. Rather than seeking traditional outdoor delights, this is a moment to savor the stillness indoors. Perhaps a visit to a cozy café, where one can lose themselves in the pages of an absorbing novel or share thoughts over warm drinks, would be a fitting escape. Otherwise, simply retreating to the familiar comforts of home with a favorite film and snacks may be just the remedy against the tempestuous backdrop.
